args.rationale:
The recommendation to purchase 800 units is infeasible because it violates node storage capacity (peak occupancy of 204.00 m³ exceeds the 200.00 m³ limit) and max days of cover policy (closing inventory of 500 units represents 29.4 days of cover, exceeding the 12-day limit of 204 units). 

Current usable inventory is 176 units with a daily forecast of 17 units (476 units total over 28 days). Without a new order, stockouts begin on 2026-09-27, resulting in 300 units of unmet demand.

Modifying the order quantity to 500 units from SUP-A ($13.00/unit, total $6,500.00) arriving on 2026-09-24 completely eliminates unmet demand (0 residual unmet), keeps peak occupancy at 198.00 m³ (within 200.00 m³ capacity), leaves 200 units closing inventory (11.8 days cover, meeting safety stock and remaining within the 12-day max cover policy), and complies with MOQ (250) and pack size (50) requirements.
assumptions: Supplier SUP-A delivers within the quoted 7-day lead time on 2026-09-24.
